units: blocks at the drawn size (hat units x scale / 16); hull frame: origin the middle of the brim face, +Y out of the hollow, +X the worn front, the boat's bow toward -Z; round (radii from the middle)

stores.note: reuses the existing 16x16 food_layer.png unchanged. Project design: tiers are total stored portions [from, to]; tier 0 draws nothing. For each other tier, f = radius_fractions[tier], R = basin floor radius: disc radius f*R, centre (x=0, z=-(1-f)*R), tangent to the bow-side wall (-Z), before the captain. Fixed hull-space UVs (+X right, +Z down), repeating at 16 pixels per block; smaller discs crop the same texture without stretching.

note: waterline_y: the fixed presentation waterline (the hull rides there, the basin dry); floor: the level floor (a shallow dimple in the middle); brim: level from the mouth to level_radius at y, then falling to its edge at outer_radius with its top at edge_y; keel_y: the hull's lowest point. captain_seat: an adult (growth 1) home and clip pose at the stern facing the bow. brim_ring: preferred hop ring; support comes from the actual underside over cloth. seating.young_max_growth: capacity and voyage reference S. load: other riders weigh weight_coefficient x size^3; capacity is weight(capacity_over_seat x S). stores: reused texture and coverage rule in stores.note.
